result.finding: The application uses two communication protocols: (1) HTTP/REST via Spring MVC for browser-to-web-module communication (Thymeleaf-rendered pages with GET/POST endpoints for file upload, listing, viewing, and deletion), and (2) AMQP via RabbitMQ for asynchronous inter-module messaging between the web module (producer) and the worker module (consumer) for image processing tasks. No gRPC, WebSocket, or TCP/UDP protocols are used.
evidence: web/S3Controller.java: @Controller, @RequestMapping, @GetMapping, @PostMapping — HTTP GET and POST endpoints
No WebSocket or TCP socket code found
values: HTTP/REST (Spring MVC): browser to web module, port 8080
AMQP/RabbitMQ: web module to worker module (async, queue: IMAGE_PROCESSING_QUEUE)
External: HTTPS to AWS S3 API (via AWS SDK v2)
